scientific_conclusion.action: Preserve observed zeros exactly as observed, preserve missing tokens as null, and keep all systematic-zero fields excluded from indicators until an authoritative data dictionary, methodology document, or independently validated source establishes their semantics.

geography_conclusion.action: Keep State_ID and District_ID source-native and uninterpreted; do not map them to LGD, Census, or current administrative codes without independent authoritative evidence.
